sentences.text: 2. Sri

.H.C.Shivaramu, learned counsel for petitioner reiterating the grounds urged in the memorandum of writ petition submits that the subject land acquired constituted Auqaf/Wakf property and same cannot be made subject matter of acquisition and the same is being used for community purpose.
3. Sri

. A.V.Gangadharappa, learned counsel for respondent No.2 draws the attention of this Court to statement of objections filed on 10.03.2017 wherein at paragraphs 2, 3 and 4 it is stated as under:
NC: 2023:KHC:33115 "2.

It is submitted that in pursuance to the acquisition of the above stated land and in view of the fact that the management of Jumma Masjid and Wakf Board made request for preservation of the land for the purpose of Idga Maidan and prayer, while passing the general award the Special Land Acquisition Officer did not pass any award determining the compensation.

The Urban Development Authority, having regard to the nature of the property, requested the State Government to delete the above stated land from acquisition as per the unanimous decision taken by the committee in its meeting held on 03.11.2004.

3. It is further submitted that the Special Land Acquisition Officer on 15.04.2004 issue Award Notice to Ghouse Sab S/o Sogane Imamsab, to receive the compensation in respect of land bearing Sy.No.353 measuring 7 acres 24 guntas by appearing in person on 15.05.2004 and further informing that in case he fails to so appear, the compensation amount will be kept in the revenue deposit and in such event he will not be entitled for any interest.

4. It is also necessary to submit that the compensation amount as determined by the Special Land Acquisition Officer has neither been paid to the owner/person interested in the land not deposited in the Civil court.
As such, the acquisition insofar as the above land is concerned, has aborted."

4. Referring to the averments made as above Sri.Gangadharappa, learned counsel further submits that the acquisition process has been aborted as the Government has decided not to acquire the subject land.
NC: 2023:KHC:33115 He further submits possession of the land still remains with the petitioner.
5. In view of the above, Petition is allowed.

Preliminary Notification dated 17.09.1984 and Final Notification dated 02.12.1987 are quashed to the extent of the land bearing Sy.No.353 measuring 7 acres 24 guntas of Urgadur Village, Madaripalya, Shivamogga, belonging to the petitioner.
